lines.zh: 我蹲在暗处，像一只箱子。
lines.en: I crouch in the dark like a chest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪动，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I shift slowly, making no sound.

lines.zh: 我用四条腿贴着地面走。
lines.en: I move on four legs close to the ground.
My latch clicks on the floor.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙根绕到你背后。
lines.en: I slide along the wall to get behind you.

lines.zh: 我的箱子盖开了一条缝。
lines.en: My lid parts a crack.
I turn back into an old chest.
I hop from spot to spot.
My teeth are inside the lid.
I head for that light.
I drag myself over the stone steps.
I stop and play dead again.
I hold perfectly still like furniture.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在暗处看不清。
lines.en: My pattern is invisible in the dark.
I wait for someone to open me.
My latch glints.
I push my boards open from the inside.
No, I am inside.
I press the lid tighter.
The dust makes me look even more like furniture.
I keep from moving.
No one comes under this lamp.
You are looking at this chest.
Will you open me?
My hands are inside the lid.
I look real, do I not?
Your hand hovers over my lock.
One more inch of that hand will do.
You are the one I have been waiting for.
The lid will spring open on its own.
Do you smell rust?
That is not a chest.
My lid clatters.
I pull back half a plank.
A plank splits.
A broken tooth stays in you.
I snap the lid shut.
I make a wooden sound.
I open again.
Something churns inside.
I have not come apart.
I have carved this blow into my wood.
You set something on me.
That is not worth opening my lid for.
What I want is on you.
You would use that as bait?
That smell does not move my teeth.
Try putting your hand in.
It would not cover the bottom of me.
I bite the lid.
Take the bait away. I want something living.
I would rather bite your fingers.
You hit the chest and it moves.
Your boot scrapes away from me.
Chests do not move on their own.
Your expression changes.
I settle back into place.
My latch clicks.
You stepped on my teeth.
A plank cracks.
I slide half a foot from the blow.
Now you know.
There is only one chest here.
Another one is deeper in the dungeon.
We keep our distance.
We are both waiting.
No lamp reaches us.
Neither chest opens its lid.
The floor creaks.
We open our lids at the same moment.
Then we close them again.
It is quiet again.
I swallow it into the chest.
It lands between my teeth.
I close the lid over it.
This is my collection.
Things inside me disappear.
I nudge it into the corner.
I look, and do not eat it.
It will rust.
I hold it in my teeth.
This goes into my collection.
You touched the latch.
The lid flies open.
I burst out of the chest.
I have more teeth than you think.
You turn around far too slowly.
I press against you.
I have been waiting for you.
The lid clicks, and then it is my turn.
My teeth close, and you stay here.
Both ends of this corridor are blocked.

lines.zh: 我的箱子盖合在你腿上。
lines.en: My lid clamps on your leg.
You are caught.
Do not struggle; it will hurt more.
I can swallow you.
My four legs push me up.
This is not a trick.
I have waited long for that footstep.

lines.zh: 你听见木板的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the wood creak?
I glide along the stone tiles.
One eye shows in the gap of my lid.
I roll up behind you.
You turn; I close my lid.
You pass; I open again.
My teeth are waiting.
You are looking for a way out.
I have crawled this corridor a hundred times.
I block the doorway.
You can only come my way.
My boards scrape forward again.
My lock rattles with each step.
You dare not come near a chest.
Yet you must come near something.
I wait for your foot to cross the threshold.
You breathe too hard. You will not get far.
I am already open.
Waiting for you.
Two more steps.
Right now. The lid is opening.
The lid clamps your arm.
My teeth sink into your leg.
I throw my whole chest onto you.

lines.zh: 我拖着你的脚往箱里送。
lines.en: I drag your foot into the chest.
The boards come down, and so do your bones.
You throw me off.
I roll upright again.
A plank splinters.
My teeth lodge in your bracer.
Your armor is gnawed open.

lines.zh: 你骨头的响声就在盖里。
lines.en: The sound of your bones is inside my lid.
I open the lid again.
The lid throws you back.
This bite is the last.
You cannot stand.
I have taken you inside.
The lid closes.
It is quiet.
One more.
Who is next?
The dungeon gains one more chest.

lines.zh: 我的盖子一开始就半开着。
lines.en: My lid is half open from the start.
My pattern matches a real chest.
I settle into position.
No lamp reaches me here.
I wait for footsteps.
My teeth line up inside the lid.
The floor is cold; that suits me.
I still my breathing.
Footsteps will come sooner or later.
I have crouched in this corner all night.
Now it begins.

lines.zh: 木头烧起来了，我赶紧合盖。
lines.en: The wood catches fire and I slam the lid.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，摔开了盖。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps and my lid flies open.
Water pours in and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸成几块木板。
lines.en: The blast blows me into splinters.
An arrow pins into my lid.
Spell-light burns through my pattern.
My empty bottom echoes when I move.
Lightning strikes and the wood blackens.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地板可以放箱子。
lines.en: There is no floor for a chest in the void.
